name: Samsung TV Remote
author: Ryan Doupe
description: A Samsung smart TV's remote in the bar: volume, D-pad, OK and Back, plus one-click launch for YouTube, Netflix, Prime Video and Spotify — sent over the TV's own Tizen remote-control WebSocket. While the popup has focus the physical arrow keys, Enter and Backspace drive the TV directly, and the bar icon takes a scroll wheel for volume. Needs nothing but Python 3; the TV shows a one-time Allow prompt on first use.

barWidget.description: Volume, arrows, OK and Back for a Samsung smart TV, plus app launch tiles. Scroll the icon for volume; arrow keys drive the TV while the popup is open.
